title: VTA did:webs DIDs Create — payload
description: Create a did:webs DID of a stated DID class — relationship, persona or service — in a context, from explicit members or a DID template: the VTA derives the keys, writes the KERI v2 inception and designation events, and publishes keri.cesr through a hosting server. Level 1. A service did:webs is optional and alpha. Alpha.

contextId.description: Context the DID belongs to. Its keys are derived here, and deleting the context destroys them.

serverId.description: The hosting server to publish through: one the VTA has registered (vta/webvh/servers/*), running with did:webs hosting enabled. Required: a did:webs DID is hosted only, since the VTA has no inbound surface to serve one from.

didClass.description: The DID class the new DID is created in, fixed for its life (VTI-KEY-190 – 193). Required: the VTA does not infer a class from a template, a context or a path. `service` makes it the durable identity of a node or a service at level 1, and is refused with `serviceDidNotPermitted` unless the VTA's configuration enables did:webs service DIDs.

path.description: Path segments before the AID. Absent puts the AID directly under the domain (`did:webs:<domain>:<AID>`). The VTA appends the AID; the caller never writes it.

domain.description: Hosting domain to publish under, when the server serves more than one. Absent uses the server's default domain. The domain is part of the DID, and is fixed once the DID designates itself.

label.description: Operator-facing label. Recorded for audit, never published.

addMediatorService.description: Designate a `#didcomm` service, typed `DIDCommMessaging`, whose endpoint is the VTA's mediator's DID. Absent means no. Not with `template`.

addTspService.description: Designate a `#tsp` service, typed `TSPTransport`, whose endpoint is the VTA's mediator's DID. Absent means no. Not with `template`.

additionalServices.description: Further services to designate. None may use `#didcomm` or `#tsp`. Not with `template`.

alsoKnownAs.description: Further DIDs to designate as aliases, such as the subject's did:webvh. The DID itself is always designated, first, and is not listed here. Not with `template`.

template.description: DID template to shape the DID from (vta/did-templates/*): its services, aliases and integration kind. The VTA reads the rendered document and designates what the did:webs derivation can express, and refuses with `templateNotRepresentable` a template it cannot (CONVENTIONS.md §9). The keys are always the VTA's. Excludes `addMediatorService`, `addTspService`, `additionalServices` and `alsoKnownAs`.

templateContext.description: Context whose templates to resolve `template` against. Absent uses the global scope, then the built-ins. Only with `template`.

templateVars.description: Variables for the template's placeholders, checked by the VTA's template renderer. Rendered into a published document: never a secret. Only with `template`.

setPrimary.description: Make this the context's primary DID. Refused with `didClassConflict` where the DID's class and the identity it would replace or become disagree (CONVENTIONS.md §1.2).

Response.title: VTA did:webs DIDs Create — response payload

aid.description: The AID: the digest of the inception event, and the DID's final segment.

didClass.description: The class the DID was created in.

slot.description: The slot published to: the path segments, then the AID.

keriCesrUrl.description: Where the key event log is served.

didJsonUrl.description: Where the document the host derives from it is served.

signingKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the signing key, the key state's one key.

signingKey.description: The signing key in CESR. Its verification method is `<did>#<signingKey>`.

nextKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the committed successor. Inactive until `vta/webs/dids/rotate-keys` installs it.

keyAgreementKeyId.description: The VTA's id for the designated X25519 key agreement key.

keyAgreementKey.description: The designated key agreement key in CESR.

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence number of the last event written: the interaction event anchoring the designations.

versionId.description: The last event as `<sequence number>:<SAID>`. A caller intending a further change passes it as `expectedVersionId`.

alsoKnownAs.description: The designated aliases, the DID itself first.

serviceIds.description: Ids of the designated services. Absent when none were designated.

primary.description: Present and true when the DID was made its context's primary DID.

template.description: The template the DID was shaped from. Present exactly when the request named one.

templateScope.description: Where `template` resolved: `builtin`, `global`, or the id of the context it was found in. Present exactly when `template` is.

templateKind.description: The template's `kind`, recorded as the DID's integration kind. Present exactly when `template` is.
